name: OpenShelf API discovery (read-only)
description: Probe the OpenShelf HTTP API and report what responds. GET-only: nothing here can move the shelf. Run this first, read the log, then write the real endpoint paths into the retrieve/store/status skills' inputs.
author: team-4

inputs.name: base_url
inputs.description: Shelf address, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080 (no trailing slash)

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: Bearer token if required. Sent as a header - never in the URL, because urls are saved into the synced project and headers are not.

nodes.label: Probe OpenShelf API
nodes.description: GET every candidate path, report status and body shape. Read-only.
